exploration.title: Semantic agent graph stack
openQuestions: Which existing beep decision should be the first consumer: a corrected claim that must reach a later action, ontology-session authoring, or agent-run memory?
Is a document-to-graph extraction pipeline in scope, or only the knowledge / memory / context role split over bricks that already exist?
When a model drafts ontology structure, what may it emit before a person accepts it?
